name: InputVenueMessageContent
description: Represents the [content](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputmessagecontent) of a venue message to be sent as the result of an inline query.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Latitude of the venue in degrees

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: Longitude of the venue in degrees

fields.name: foursquare_id
fields.description: Foursquare identifier of the venue, if known

fields.name: foursquare_type
fields.description: Foursquare type of the venue, if known. (For example, “arts\_entertainment/default”, “arts\_entertainment/aquarium” or “food/icecream”.)

fields.name: google_place_id
fields.description: Google Places identifier of the venue

fields.name: google_place_type
fields.description: Google Places type of the venue. (See [supported types](https://developers.google.com/places/web-service/supported_types).)
